answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 38201 Country: India Title: essa-le-sawaab Question: Who can recite Quran for marhoom as eesal-e-sawaab only children and wife OR all the relatives can recite? Answer ID: 38201 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 712/712/M=1433) Any one whether a relative or other can recite the Quran for the Isal-e-Sawab of the deceased. But, you should avoid the prevalent collective Quran Khwani system. One should individually do isal-e-sawab any time without specifying any fixed time for the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
